title: Zoning text change for 47-03 108th Street, Queens
summary: This zoning text amendment would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for a site at 47-03 108th Street in Corona, Queens, working alongside a related map change from R6B to R7X/C2-4. Together the actions would allow a 13-story mixed-use building with about 119 apartments, of which 30 would be income-restricted, plus commercial and community facility space.
